items.text: Sprint 1: Classify & Map (Workstream D + the E split decision) — canonical system-boundary map (ownership/contract/test-coverage/is-this-SDK-core-or-app-private)
Sprint 2 (most urgent, Workstream C): Reliability - make the apps load; warm projection cache fast path, SW zip-unpack true fallback, render-verified on both doorways
Sprint 3 (Workstream A): Elohim SDK contract + standard app-bootstrap (provideElohimApp giving DI providers + doorway resolution + SW/cache wiring for free)
Sprint 4 (Workstream B): app-manifest formalization + one reference-app conforming end-to-end with no hand-wiring
Sprint 5 (Workstream E): pipeline/monorepo split execution (elohim-core vs reference-apps) if decided in Sprint 1
Baseline fixes SHIPPED 2026-05-30 PM (a4ca81d89 + 3e2baaa68): provide missing DI tokens + same-origin doorway in projected bundles — sprints start from working code
